# Runwall

> Zero-trust governance and policy-enforcement platform for AI agents, built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Intercepts agent tool calls and enforces policy without requiring code changes to the agent stack.

Runwall sits as a proxy between AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) and the tools they call, applying OPA/Rego policy rules, taint tracking, and semantic risk scoring in real time.

## Getting Started
- [Getting Started](https://runwall.in/docs/getting-started): How to connect Runwall to an existing MCP-based agent stack
- [Documentation Hub](https://runwall.in/docs): Full documentation with sidebar navigation

## Docs
- [MCP Protocol Broker](https://runwall.in/docs/mcp): How Runwall proxies MCP and manages the tool registry
- [Policy Engine](https://runwall.in/docs/policies): OPA/Rego policy authoring for per-tool-call governance
- [Risk Scoring Engine](https://runwall.in/docs/risk): Real-time risk assessment for agent tool invocations
- [Taint Tracking & DLP](https://runwall.in/docs/taint): Session-level taint tracking to prevent data exfiltration
- [Approval Workflows](https://runwall.in/docs/approvals): Human-in-the-loop, log-and-allow, and hard block modes
- [Audit Log & Evidence Replay](https://runwall.in/docs/audit): Immutable audit trail with forensic session replay

## Security
- [Security Overview](https://runwall.in/security): Zero-trust security model and defense-in-depth architecture

- [Threat Model](https://runwall.in/security/threat-model): Prompt injection, tool poisoning, data exfiltration, runaway loops
- [Security Testing](https://runwall.in/security/testing): Adversarial audit case study (2.1→9.1 score progression)
- [Responsible Disclosure](https://runwall.in/security/responsible-disclosure): How to report security vulnerabilities

## Use Cases
- [Coding Agents](https://runwall.in/use-cases/coding-agents): Governance for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot with terminal/file access
- [Enterprise MCP](https://runwall.in/use-cases/enterprise-mcp): Multi-tenant governance, per-tenant policies, SLA enforcement
- [Autonomous Agents](https://runwall.in/use-cases/autonomous-agents): Runaway loop protection, rate limits, quotas, rollback
- [Sensitive Data](https://runwall.in/use-cases/sensitive-data): Taint tracking and DLP for data exfiltration prevention
